scope: Initial native HTTP response ownership, independently of browser handoff
status: Confirmed open implementation gap; no production changes in this audit
finding: The bytes=0-0 probe spends the only accepted GET on range-aware single-use URLs. The next request fails HTTP 410 at both one and eight configured connections.
requirements: Retain the initial file response instead of consuming a disposable byte-range probe.
Preserve parallel range transfer, exact-byte validation, resumed-file validators and refreshed-address validation.
Do not substitute retrying or refreshing the URL for ownership of the original response.
Browser-issued response adoption remains separate and incomplete.
reference: docs/reverse-engineering-0.10.md records IDM beginning a local download with a normal GET followed by additional ranges; it does not prove universal single-use behavior.
